calls.title: Webinar Content Sync
calls.summary: Ben Fanning (Growth Engineer at Fixer) and Ashley Stirrup (GrowthBook) discussed Fixer's experimentation journey, highlighting how they automated growth engineering workflows using GrowthBook, AI agents, and a custom power calculator to eliminate manual tasks and scale experimentation. Key pain points included manual analysis, overwhelming onboarding, and the need for rigor as the team grows. Next steps: Ben will send Fixer corporate slides, screenshots of cursor skills, an experiment one-pager, and coordinate a practice session with Leia; Ashley will produce blog, social posts, and a YouTube video.
